title: FilesReadParams
description: Params of the files.read agent tool (design §4.2): read a file within the grant's paths. The model is untrusted input and gets the same check the renderer's parameters get — additionalProperties: false plus an explicit required list, and a bound on the path it may name (the grant's paths, enforced by the narrowed capability nocx-lndv constructs). Windowing of the return is the tool's return contract (design §4.4), not a parameter of this slice.

path.description: Path of the file to read, inside the grant's paths.

result.title: FilesReadResult
result.description: What files.read hands back. Binary content is REPORTED, never pasted: binary is true and text is absent, so a model asking for an image gets a fact rather than a screenful of bytes.

start.description: First line of the window returned, in bytes, counting from 0.

end.description: One past the last line of the window returned, in bytes.

window.description: The byte span returned: [0, size of the window).

returned.description: Bytes actually returned. Less than total means the file is longer than the window.

binary.description: True when the content is binary. Absent means false.

text.description: The text of the returned window. Absent for binary content and for an empty file.
